subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Ler e escrever, corretamente, palavras com sílabas VV e CVV em casos nos quais a combinação VV (ditongo) é reduzida na língua oral (ai, ei, ou).

components.description_pt: Reconhecer padrões silábicos VV e CVV contendo ditongos reduzidos na linguagem falada
components.description_en: Recognize VV and CVV syllable patterns containing diphthongs reduced in spoken language
components.cc_component_description: Decode multisyllabic words using knowledge of common syllable patterns

components.description_pt: Ler corretamente palavras contendo os ditongos ai, ei e ou
components.description_en: Read words correctly that contain the diphthongs ai, ei, and ou
components.cc_component_description: Identify and read words with common vowel teams and final-e patterns

cc_matches.description: Know and apply grade-level phonics and word analysis skills in decoding words.
Know and apply grade-level phonics and word analysis skills in decoding words.
